lead: A `-p nvs-stdlib` test reads an empty sentence off `ctx.take_pending()` for a `ParseError` thrown with an issue list.
body: `Fault::thrown_with_issues` (every `Core\Json` decode refusal, `Core\Http\Response::jsonAs`'s not-UTF-8 body) leaves `take_pending` answering `""` under a bare `Ctx::buffered()`, so a `message.contains(…)` assertion fails and reads as the member saying nothing. Assert `is_err()` from Rust and pin the sentence from Novis, the way `response_json_as_hydrates_a_shape_twice_and_refuses_a_bad_depth_and_a_non_text_body` points at `docs/examples/core/Http-Response/jsonAs/02-a-reply-that-is-not-json.nvs`.
